command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
# The whole ChEMBL 37 chemreps release, fetched on AWS from EBI and checked against the sha256 EBI
# publishes in releases/chembl_37/checksums.txt before it is kept.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
import hashlib, urllib.request
URL = "https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/chembl/ChEMBLdb/releases/chembl_37/chembl_37_chemreps.txt.gz"
WANT = "ea6181ce8dc7af41974e35b92e1febb0c9dcbe2c62f7ccc4a5d983ac19f696e7"
h = hashlib.sha256()
with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=600) as r, open("chembl_37_chemreps.txt.gz", "wb") as fh:
    while True:
        b = r.read(1 << 20)
        if not b:
            break
        h.update(b); fh.write(b)
got = h.hexdigest()
print("sha256", got, "EBI checksums.txt", WANT)
assert got == WANT, "sha256 does not match EBI's published checksum"
PYEOF
sha256sum chembl_37_chemreps.txt.gz | tee data.sha256
ls -l
echo DONE
